children: Tenon Medical repaid in full approximately $5.16 million of original issue discount senior convertible notes ahead of their Sept. 11, 2026 maturity.
Repaid outstanding original issue discount senior convertible notes with aggregate principal ~ $5.16M ahead of maturity.
Repayment eliminates potential conversion of notes into common stock at a discount, reducing shareholder dilution risk.
Company says action strengthens its balance sheet and provides greater flexibility to fund commercialization and growth initiatives.
Notes were issued March 11, 2026; repayment is positioned to support ongoing commercial execution and adoption of products.
